invariants.rationale: Ensures the input List of records is not null before processing.
A typical precondition is that the number of output partitions for repartitioning should be positive.
The size of a Java List is always non-negative.
It is common to require that the list does not contain any null records before repartitioning and sorting.
It makes sense to expect that you do not repartition into more partitions than there are records, unless the input list is empty.
